recipe.description: Owen Pike original masculine-presenting art direction: longer narrow head, tapered jaw with modest chin, restrained nose width, gently laid-back ears and a substantial spreading neck. Upstream parameter labels identify graphical controls only; they establish neither ethnicity, literal age, gender identity nor palette.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
